stable.label: deep-world-standalone-ci-pass-active-integration-tested
stable.note: The standalone deep-world foundation retains its prior CI evidence, but active navigation integration changed after discovering that surface crawlers could be assigned deep/cave A* routes they could not physically execute. The active engine is therefore TESTED until fresh integration CI passes.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript modules + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: persistent chunked 2D material-volume state remains active for geology, caves, underground water, atmosphere, support, moisture and nutrients
default cave/terrain/liquid rendering hides cell rectangles and uses extracted smoothed contours
surface crawlers use persistent terrain-aware surface routes with slope, water-depth and instability costs
steering direction and locomotion speed are low-pass filtered rather than snapping every tick
deep A* routing is now capability-gated: only a body explicitly marked locomotionMode=volume may receive a cave-cell route
current crawlers remain surface locomotors, so they no longer receive routes their physical motor cannot execute
render pose smoothing remains presentation-only and never writes back into physics state
approximations: current crawler motor is surface-bound and cannot yet execute arbitrary vertical cave traversal
deep A* is retained for future compatible climbing/swimming/volume bodies but is not used by current surface crawlers
surface route planning is a side-view corridor planner rather than a general 2D navmesh
deep liquid transport remains a cellular conservative approximation rather than CFD
smooth contour rendering does not increase simulation resolution
ALife drive arbitration is authored and is not learning

scratch_engine.pending_ci_reason: navigation capability boundary changed after active surface crawler/deep-route mismatch was identified

deep_world.truth: persistent 2D cells are simulation state; default renderer hides the grid behind extracted/smoothed contours

scratch_navigation.truth: surface crawlers use surface routes; deep A* requires an explicitly compatible volume locomotion body

scratch_alife.note: ALife source is unchanged, but its navigation integration changed and needs fresh regression CI.

scratch_environment.note: Standalone environment subsystem evidence remains valid.

active_objective: Pass fresh CI for the locomotion-compatible navigation boundary, then exercise the deployed iPhone build for smoother routing and non-blocky cave/liquid presentation.
next_gate: Fresh Codehood and Foundation CI must cover the corrected navigation integration. LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED still require deployed browser/iPhone execution afterward.
invariants: Do not render simulation cells as visible block tiles
Do not give an agent a path its body locomotion cannot execute
Do not call the surface planner a general 2D navmesh
Do not call presentation interpolation physics
Do not call authored ALife learning
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
